name: Ami Bera

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JUHIE PARIKH COMMEMORATES AMERICA'S 250TH ANNIVERSARY
statements.title: JUHIE PARIKH COMMEMORATES AMERICA'S 250TH ANNIVERSARY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I would like to share her essay in her own words: As I look out onto my street in a Sacramento suburb, I see a lovely Chinese family with two daughters achieving their dreams in college, a Black family with two daughters in high school with me, a Mexican family with three children that love playing soccer, college students renting a house, three generations of a White family and their cute dog named Liesel who pass out homemade cinnamon rolls every Christmas to each house, and my own Indian immigrant family.
Recognizing 20th Anniversary of Citrus Heights Police Department Mr. Speaker, I rise today to recognize the 20th anniversary of the Citrus Heights Police Department.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BLOCK THE USE OF TRANSATLANTIC TECHNOLOGY IN IRANIAN MADE DRONES ACT
statements.title: BLOCK THE USE OF TRANSATLANTIC TECHNOLOGY IN IRANIAN MADE DRONES ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 2505, the Block the Use of Transatlantic Technology in Iranian Made Drones Act.

I thank my colleague from Massachusetts, Representative Keating, for his leadership in advancing bipartisan efforts to counter Iran's drone program, a threat that continues to hound Ukraine, and now our own forces and allies in the Middle East.
Since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Iran has exported thousands of Shahed drones to the Russian military, fueling attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and civilians.
Now, Iranian drones continue to threaten and damage critical energy, military, and civilian infrastructure across the Middle East.
Most recently, Iranian drones struck Kuwait International Airport, heavily damaging a passenger terminal, killing one person, wounding dozens more, and briefly closing the airfield.
I encourage my colleagues to support this bipartisan bill to help ensure that the United States and European technologies smuggled by illicit intermediaries don't fuel Iran's drone program.
Mr. Speaker, this bill closes a critical gap in enforcement to ensure that U.S. and European technologies don't fuel Iran's drone program.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: US-JAPAN-ROK TRILATERAL COOPERATION ACT
statements.title: US-JAPAN-ROK TRILATERAL COOPERATION ACT
sentences: Whether it is the challenges posed by North Korea or the People's Republic of China, trilateral cooperation is one of the critical ways to ensure that America and our two closest allies in Asia are working hand in hand toward our common interests and advancement of peace and prosperity in the region.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 3429, the U.S.-Japan-ROK Trilateral Cooperation Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all my colleagues to support this measure.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNITED STATES COMMISSION ON INTERNATIONAL RELIGIOUS FREEDOM REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2026
statements.title: UNITED STATES COMMISSION ON INTERNATIONAL RELIGIOUS FREEDOM REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2026
sentences: True religious liberty cannot mean protection for only a favored few.
In many parts of the world, severe restrictions on religion are an early warning sign of authoritarian consolidation and instability.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of this bill to reauthorize the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom, or USCIRF, through fiscal year 2028.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING EUROPE FROM ANTISEMITIC CRIME AND EXTREMISM ACT
statements.title: PROTECTING EUROPE FROM ANTISEMITIC CRIME AND EXTREMISM ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the PEACE Act.
Mr. Speaker, I support this bill and urge my colleagues to do the same.
Mr. Speaker, I support this measure.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRODUCING RETURNS AND OPPORTUNITY FOR INVESTMENT AND TRADE ACT OF 2026
statements.title: PRODUCING RETURNS AND OPPORTUNITY FOR INVESTMENT AND TRADE ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 5248, and I thank Representative Young Kim and Chairman Mast for working to move this package of economic diplomacy measures in a bipartisan manner.
Mr. Speaker, I support this measure, and I urge all of my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TEHRAN INCITEMENT TO VIOLENCE ACT
statements.title: TEHRAN INCITEMENT TO VIOLENCE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of passage of H.R. 6230, a bill that seeks to apply standard International Emergency Economic Powers Act, or IEEPA, property-blocking sanctions against a set of Iranian religious and government figures, as well as the institutions they represent, who have publicly threatened the life of the President of the United States and allied leaders.
Additional listings may feel satisfying, but they will not on their own cause a meaningful change in Iran's calculus or behavior.

What we need from the Trump administration is an end to this costly war, followed by a clear articulation on an Iran strategy that protects the American people, supports our partners, and restores credible diplomacy.
Mr. Speaker, I support this bill because threats made against the United States President and others by those this legislation targets are completely unacceptable.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEVELOPING OVERSEAS MINERAL INVESTMENTS AND NEW ALLIED NETWORKS FOR CRITICAL ENERGIES ACT
statements.title: DEVELOPING OVERSEAS MINERAL INVESTMENTS AND NEW ALLIED NETWORKS FOR CRITICAL ENERGIES ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 7037, the Developing Overseas Mineral Investments and New Allied Networks for Critical Energies Act, or the DOMINANCE Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ALLIED DEFENSE SALES ACT
statements.title: ALLIED DEFENSE SALES ACT
sentences: This bill directs the Secretary of State to develop and implement a strategy to encourage U.S. foreign partners to participate in the foreign military sales, FMS, and direct commercial sales, DCS, processes on a multinational basis.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of a bill I co-led with Representative Zinke regarding the promotion of multicountry defense article purchases, which can result in lower prices, greater efficiencies, and interoperability for our allies and partners.
I support this bill and encourage my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COUNTERING CHINA'S CONTROL OF THE CAUCASUS ACT
statements.title: COUNTERING CHINA'S CONTROL OF THE CAUCASUS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 7668, a bipartisan bill designed to make sure the United States is clear-eyed about the threats from Russia and the PRC in Georgia as well as whether Georgia remains committed to a relationship with the United States and Europe centered around shared values and interests.
The goal is to let the Georgian people know that we stand by them in their quest for democracy, respect for their rights, and deeper integration in the Euro-Atlantic community.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP ILLEGAL FISHING ACT
statements.title: STOP ILLEGAL FISHING ACT
sentences: Yet, too often, foreign vessels engage in illegal fishing practices that deplete fish stocks, undermine local economies, and erode the ability of Pacific nations to manage their own maritime resources.
Countries like China, Iran, and Russia are willfully or, at best, negligently violating international law, undermining human rights, and hurting communities for their own benefit.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of Ranking Member Meeks' legislation, H.R. 6338, the Stop Illegal Fishing Act.

statements.title: FAREWELL TO KELVIN LUM
sentences: While we will all miss Kelvin in our office, I know that the work he has done here will continue to have a lasting impact.
